sections.title: Expressing transformation into a state or object
sections.content: You know the translative *-vá / -vé* from A2 Unit 35: it says what something becomes or is turned into (*otthonná* = into a home, *szebbé* = into prettier). After a consonant the *v* turns into that consonant: *ház + -vá = házzá*, *lakás + -vá = lakássá*, *kert + -vé = kertté*. Here you use it for home projects.

items.spanish: Az új lámpa otthonossá teszi a szobát.
items.english: The new lamp makes the room homely.
We are converting the small room into an office.

items.spanish: Az új függöny barátságossá teszi a nappalit.
items.english: The new curtain makes the living room friendly.
